verdict.rationale: Sketch ships an official CLI, `sketchtool`, documented for asset creation and integration into workflows/server applications on any platform, which agentic/AI tools could invoke. However, there's no evidence this CLI is positioned or extended for AI-native agent workflows specifically (no mention of AI agents using sketchtool, no JSON/agent-friendly output specs, and MCP support is a separate non-CLI integration). Missing for 10: agent-oriented CLI documentation, examples of AI/agent usage of sketchtool, independent hands-on confirmation of its use in automated pipelines.
